description: ALL WHEEL DRIVE XTS PLATINUM, MASSAGING SEATS, BOSE SURROUND, 56,114 MILES  All wheel drive, front seats that heat, ventilate and massage, a 14 speaker Bose Studio Surround system and a head up display. This 2018 Cadillac XTS Platinum in Dark Adriatic Blue Metallic is the quiet way to arrive, and it has 56,114 miles on it.  Platinum is the top of the XTS range and it is not subtle about it. Heated and ventilated front seats with massage, four way power lumbar for the driver and the front passenger, thigh adjusters on both front seats, memory for the seat and the steering wheel, heated rear seats for the people behind you, and a heated steering wheel wrapped in leather. Genuine wood inserts on the dashboard, the doors and the console. Illuminated Platinum front sill plates when you open the door.  The chassis is the part people underestimate. All wheel drive with adaptive suspension, auto leveling and four wheel independent suspension underneath, plus power variable effort steering. It settles into the Interstate 182 run the way a big Cadillac should, and the all wheel drive means the first ice on Columbia Center Boulevard is somebody else's problem.  Climate and comfort are sorted for everyone aboard. Tri zone automatic climate control with dual zone up front and rear air conditioning behind, a rear window blind, rear audio controls and a rear seat center armrest. An UltraView power moonroof opens most of the roof.  The technology holds up. A 12.3 inch color reconfigurable gauge cluster, a head up display on the windshield, Cadillac User Experience with embedded navigation, Apple CarPlay and Android Auto, and SiriusXM with HD radio through fourteen Bose Studio Surround speakers. A garage door transmitter, compass, auto dimming rear view and door mirrors, and an auto tilt away steering wheel that gets out of your way when you park.  The Driver Assist Package adds active cruise control with front and rear automatic braking. Auto high beam headlights, fully automatic headlights, rain sensing wipers, heated power door mirrors with turn signal indicators and a rear parking camera. Outside, a dual outlet stainless steel exhaust, a rear spoiler, body color bumpers and 20 inch ultra bright machined aluminum wheels. The Interior Protection Package brought all weather floor mats and a cargo mat.  CARFAX reports no accidents or damage, a clean title and no total loss, and it was last owned right here in Washington. Odometer reads 56,114 miles.  Come sit in it at Archibald's, 6902 W Clearwater Ave in Kennewick, or call us at 509-737-1199.
